name: i wish ...Todoke Kono Omoi
source:
Rush is a miner who dreams of doing something big someday. One day he sets on a journey to find secret treasure that makes wishes come true. His childhood friend Latia joins him on this adventure journey. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-february-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
矿工拉什一直梦想着有朝一日能干出一番大事业。一天，他踏上旅途，寻找能实现愿望的秘宝。青梅竹马拉缇娅也加入这场冒险。

[译自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-february-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
